title: Verdict on a concatenation of fixed lengths
statement: Let $x$ and $u$ be Boolean words such that $|u|=|x|+1$. The verifier verdict on their concatenation equals the conjunction of the mode-guarded width-three test of the formula decoded from $x$ and the evaluation of that formula under the assignment carried by $u$.
hypotheses_covered: the mode flag is either true or false
replaced:
Let $x$ and $u$ be binary words with $|u| = |x| + 1$. Then the verifier verdict on
the concatenation $x \mathbin{+\!\!+} u$ equals the conjunction of the (mode-guarded)
width-three test of the formula decoded from $x$ with the evaluation of that formula
under the assignment read off $u$.
